messages:
Jordan: Heads-up: hotel in SFO placed a $200 incidental hold overnight, they say it might post if minibar used. I only needed room, not sure if we should cover incidental holds while traveling.
Samir (Finance): Incidental authorization holds are not reimbursed by default. We cover actual charges posted to the card, not temporary pre-auths. If the hold posts as a charge, submit the folio and we'll reimburse.
Jordan: Okay but the hold reduced my available personal funds and triggered overdraft from my bank. Can we request CardOps to push merchants to use a $0 auth for corp cards?
Samir (Finance): We can ask but some hotels require a hold. CardOps, can you check MCC policy for hotel auth amounts and whether corporate cards can be configured for $0 incidental?
CardOps Bot: New ticket CO-2026-510 opened to review hotel authorizations and corporate card incidental limits. ETA 48h.
Morgan (People Ops): Jordan, we can issue a one-time travel advance to cover overdraft fees and restore your available funds. If you want that, DM me the amount and bank fee screenshot.
Jordan: Thanks Morgan, I paid $35 overdraft fee. I'll DM you the screenshot.
Samir (Finance): Jordan, when filing the eventual expense, attach folio and any posted charges. For the overdraft fee, include bank statement screenshot and note 'bank fee due to corp card hold'. We'll review for reimbursement.
Jordan: Filing now. Also attaching hotel folio link: https://drive.redwood/receipts/1845601234-hotel-folio.pdf
CardOps Bot: Update CO-2026-510: initial review shows most hotels use a merchant-initiated pre-auth. CardOps recommends adding an FAQ entry and asking top hotel vendors if they support reduced pre-auths for corporate BINs.
Samir (Finance): Good plan. We'll follow up with TravelOps to add guidance and with vendor ops to request reduced holds where feasible. Jordan, we'll reimburse the $35 once Docs attached.
Jordan: Appreciate it, thanks all.
